cutoff_means: Base commits were read at the cutoff and every copy started after it. The database copy is one consistent read snapshot taken between its part's started and finished times. Transcript and session files were still being appended while they were copied, so a copy may hold records written after the cutoff, up to its part's finished time; readers needing a strict window drop records time-stamped after the cutoff. Sizes and hashes describe the copies, not the sources.

t3_database.method: sqlite3 CLI .backup of the source opened read-only (mode=ro), inside one read transaction; the copy then set to journal_mode=DELETE. Open it with ?mode=ro.
